verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device inference SDK that downloads model files, so runtime-to-model-file compatibility is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never addresses model-file format versioning, compatibility guarantees across runtime upgrades, or migration guidance. Download-progress and cross-platform-consistency docs are about different capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether upgrading the runtime can break compatibility with previously downloaded quantized model files
